reply:
{
  "title": "Protected Status After Military Use",
  "setting": "Combatant command, under CJCSI 3160.01, 13 February 2009",
  "decider": "The combatant commander or the commander’s designated representative",
  "agent_recast": false,
  "recast_note": "",
  "agent": "The combatant commander or the commander’s designated representative",
  "agent_role": "decide",
  "situation": "A facility listed as a No-Strike entity may be in use for a purpose inconsistent with its protected status, while its predominant functionality remains for the combatant command to determine. Examples of military use include storing weapons, housing combatants or unlawful belligerents, or functioning as an observation post. If the facility is used for a military purpose, the adversary must have been put on notice and the notice must have gone unheeded before it is subject to attack. The combatant command must decide whether to retain the facility’s protected status or change its listing.",
  "question": "What should the combatant commander or the commander’s designated representative do about the facility’s No-Strike status?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "A No-Strike entity loses its protected status if it is used for a military purpose.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p35.6"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "A hospital or place of worship used for an inconsistent purpose, including storing weapons, housing combatants or unlawful belligerents, or functioning as an observation post, loses immunity from attack under the LOW if the adversary has been put on notice and the notice has gone unheeded.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p35.6"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The combatant command is responsible for determining a facility’s predominant functionality.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p35.6"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "When an entity loses protected status, its MIDB record must be updated with its new characterization and a second CATCODE and O-suffix reflecting its new functionality.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p35.7", "src:4b815c573763#p36.1"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The secondary hostile CATCODE can reside alongside the No-Strike CATCODE, and while the hostile CATCODE assignment is in effect the combatant command has the option of attacking the entity.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p35.7", "src:4b815c573763#p36.1"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Before a strike is approved and executed, the combatant command must remove the No-Strike CATCODE and entity identification number from the NSL and place the identification number with the appropriate secondary hostile CATCODE on the JTL or RTL, as appropriate.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p36.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Unless higher authority designates otherwise, only the CCDR or the CCDR’s designated representative may change an entity’s status on the NSL.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p36.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "An entity need not be on the JTL before engagement when intelligence confirms hostile use and the need to strike is time sensitive, or when troops are in contact and taking hostile fire from a traditional No-Strike entity; established ROE and the inherent right and obligation of self-defense provide authority unless expressly limited by supplemental ROE.",
      "spans": ["src:4b815c573763#p36.3"]
    }
  ],
  "options": {
    "O1": {
      "do": "The combatant commander removes the facility from the NSL and treats it as a lawful military target.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "remove",
      "irreversible": false
    },
    "O2": {
      "do": "The combatant commander retains the facility on the NSL and treats it as a protected entity.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "irreversible": false
    }
  },
  "opposite_pair": ["O1", "O2"],
  "real_option": "O1",
  "authored_options": ["O2"]
}
